tagline_zh: 外防晒内补水 · 自然粉肤色 · 清爽自然光感
overview_en: A daily broad-spectrum sunscreen rich in Witch Hazel water and hyaluronic acid that protects against harmful UVA and UVB rays, with a non-greasy, lightweight feel.
overview_zh: 富含北美金缕梅水和透明质酸的日常防晒，保护肌肤免受有害紫外线（UVA & UVB）伤害，质地清爽不油腻、轻盈。
benefits_zh: 防止水分流失，长达12小时保湿
肌肤平滑，呈现年轻光感
how_to_use_en: After toner and moisturiser, apply evenly to face and neck until absorbed.
Use every morning, 20 minutes before outdoor activity.
how_to_use_zh: 于爽肤水与乳霜后，均匀涂抹于脸部与颈部至吸收。
每天早上出门前20分钟使用。
